commands.review_summary:
The branch adds an in-call boolean in the Codex plugin thread-config builder to skip later app inventory refreshes after an earlier refresh in the same request.

PR surface: Source +12. Total +12 across 1 file.

Reproducibility: yes. source-reproducible: current main intentionally follows a non-forced initial app inventory refresh with a forced not-ready repair when plugin apps remain unavailable. The PR's new flag suppresses that second branch after the first refresh; I did not run a live Codex app-server scenario in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The PR needs author or maintainer revision plus real behavior proof; ClawSweeper should not auto-repair while the contributor proof gate is unmet.
